destination.name: Munnar
destination.description: A beautiful hill station in Kerala, famous for its lush tea plantations, misty mountains, and cool climate.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cusco
itinerary.description: Airport pickup, hotel check-in and leisure time to acclimatize to the altitude.

itinerary.title: Sacred Valley
itinerary.description: Visit Pisac Market, Ollantaytambo Fortress and enjoy scenic Andean landscapes.

itinerary.title: Machu Picchu
itinerary.description: Travel by Vistadome train and enjoy a guided tour of the magnificent Machu Picchu.

itinerary.title: Cusco Heritage Tour
itinerary.description: Explore Sacsayhuamán, Qorikancha Temple and Cusco Plaza de Armas.

itinerary.title: Free Exploration
itinerary.description: Enjoy shopping, local cafés and optional adventure activities around Cusco.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast, hotel checkout and transfer to Alejandro Velasco Astete International Airport.

packages.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 72 hours before departure.
